name: Ashapura Minechem Ltd
tagline: Bentonite/bauxite mining and mineral-processing company with strong headline fundamentals (ROCE ~17%, ROE ~27%, revenue growth ~12.5% CAGR) undercut by a genuine, verified criminal conviction of the company and its MD in the Belekeri (Karnataka) illegal iron-ore export case.
business_overview: Ashapura Minechem (NSE: ASHAPURMIN) is a mining and mineral-processing company specialising in bentonite, bauxite and related industrial minerals, controlled by the Shah promoter group (MD Chetan Navnitlal Shah). Seeded via untrusted X triage (@StocksResearch +1 more, bullish, high conviction, 2026-09-13).
fundamentals_narrative: Headline fundamentals (ROCE/ROE/growth) are genuinely strong and would normally warrant full small/mid-cap four-box scoring. However, the company and its MD Chetan Shah were criminally convicted on 26 October 2024 by a Special CBI Court (Bengaluru) under IPC Sections 120-B/420/379 in the long-running Belekeri illegal iron-ore export case (with Mallikarjun Shipping Pvt Ltd and others), carrying a joint penalty of ~Rs 9.06 Cr and individual sentences of up to 7 years' imprisonment for the individuals involved. The Karnataka High Court has since admitted an appeal and suspended the conviction/sentence (25% of the fine deposited pending appeal), so this is not a closed, spent matter - it is an active, ongoing criminal/legal process directly involving the company and its MD. Separately, SEBI issued a Rs 2 lakh adjudication order (Feb 2026) for disclosure-lapse violations under LODR Reg 30(2) - minor on its own, but consistent with a pattern of governance/compliance friction.
